verdict.rationale: The only signals are version-aware API docs: a navbar version dropdown for switching between versions (typesense-docs-57) and a 'latest' API reference path (typesense-docs-45). A versioned '/mcp/v1' endpoint is also documented (typesense-docs-53). Nothing in the pack describes how breaking changes are handled or what deprecation policy applies, so only the versioning half of the story has thin support. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme or compatibility guarantees, a documented deprecation policy with timelines/notices, changelog or migration guidance between versions, independent corroboration.
